duplicate_policy: One identical train-image pair grouped; same boxes, two published MOS vectors retained; average separately computed annotation-set losses. No relabeling, no candidate deletion.
label_policy: Exclude only official -2 sentinel; retain six published MOS values 0.86/0.93 without clipping; use nominal (MOS-1)/4 affine scale, valid normalized range [-0.035,1]. No inferred or corrected human labels.
coordinates: native y1 x1 y2 x2 reordered to xyxy; pixel-edge convention as official Python crop slicing; no +/-1 shift
